title: Hooded Sweatshirt
subtitle: Burgundy cropped raglan / drawcord hood / rib trims
status: PROPOSED DEVELOPMENT SPECIFICATION — SAMPLE VALIDATION REQUIRED
fit: Relaxed cropped body, full raglan sleeves, gathered into close rib cuffs and waistband.
market: Adult Womenswear / EU-labelled development range; no UK conversion implied

bom.specification: PROPOSED loopback or brushed sweatshirt knit 300–340 g/m²; ≥20% cross extension
PROPOSED 2×2 rib, 300–360 g/m²; ≥60% usable extension and recovery compatible with F01
PROPOSED round 5 mm soft cord, no metal aglets; heat/knotted ends after material trial
Soft fusible knit patches 25 × 25 mm; peel/strike-through trial
10 mm soft jersey tape, compatible extension; no hard woven binding
Polyester Tex 30 needle and soft looper; Nm 80–90 ballpoint after ply trial
bom.placement: 514 joins / 301 hood, channel and neck tape

bom.specification: Neutral development identity; retail care content withheld
bom.placement: Inside back neck tape / left side seam

bom.specification: Hood folded inward without crushing cord; size to cooled sample

operations.method: Front/back raglan seam 6 mm SA / 514 four-thread overedge, 3 mm stitch. Match neck and underarm notches; no set-in armhole or separate shoulder seam. Optional cover row not specified; visible source seam lines represented only.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Self-lined hood, 10 mm bagged face-edge SA / 301, 3 mm. Channel stitch 25 mm from finished opening, 301 / 3 mm, keeping needle out of cord. Two 8 mm stitched buttonholes on I01 reinforcement, centres 18 mm above neckline and 18 mm from CF edge; no metal eyelets.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Finish 8 cm band; ring join 6 mm / 514. Proposed seam-line rib/body attachment ratio 0.80 (80/100 cm base). Quarter-match and distribute body fullness; 6 mm / 514, 3 mm stitch; recovery trial before approval.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Finish 7 cm cuff, proposed seam-line cuff/sleeve-opening ratio 0.75. Close cuff ring / 6 mm 514; fold and attach evenly without tucks. Do not stretch body sleeve during pressing.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Outer and inner hood each two mirrored halves. Join CB curve 10 mm SA / 301, 3 mm, press allowances apart on ham. Bag outer/inner face; turn, channel stitch. No unsupported third centre strip.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Hood neck seam 10 mm / 514 at 3 mm; match CF, CB and raglan junctions. Cover inside back seam with N01, 301 / 3 mm, secure only to allowance/inside where possible to avoid invented face topstitch.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Close from sleeve cuff to lower body edge, 6 mm SA / 514, 3 mm. Match raglan seam intersections; allowance toward back. Rib rings attached after body closure.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

operations.method: Thread D01 through channel after stitching. Proposed cut 125 cm, knot ends; aim equal exposed lengths with hood open. L01 on neck tape and inner left side. Adult market/cord entrapment review before production.
operations.status: PROPOSED method / source-visible feature unless noted

details: Two outer + two inner mirrored hood halves. 25 mm face channel; stitched exits reinforced with 25 mm patches; no eyelets.
8 cm hem / 7 cm cuff; proposed 0.80 hem and 0.75 cuff seam-line ratios; no inserted waist elastic.
6 mm raglan join / 514; 10 mm hood attachment; soft 10 mm tape covers back seam allowance.
pattern: Front ×1 on fold, back ×1 on fold, raglan sleeves ×2 mirrored, outer hood halves ×2, inner hood halves ×2, rib hem band ×1, rib cuffs ×2. PROPOSED components, no measured pattern claim.
Walk front/back raglan lengths independently; place notches clear of underarm; retain sleeve pitch.
Hood neck seam length must equal completed neckline excluding overlap; face channel must clear lining and cord exits.
Rib ratios at base: hem 80/100 = 0.80; cuff seam-line ring 18/24 = 0.75 (opening is narrower after shaping). Refit using actual rib recovery; do not apply same ratio blindly to every size.
assembly: Relax shell/rib; wash and recovery-test together; approve compatible shrinkage.
Cut body/sleeves and mirrored hood halves; fuse exit patches.
Make stitched hood exits; join outer/inner CB hood curves.
Bag face edge, turn and form channel before inserting cord.
Join raglan sleeves; close underarms/sides with matched junctions.
Attach hood; cover inside back neck seam with soft tape/ID.
Prepare and attach rib rings; insert cord and knot ends.
Steam lightly, cool/relax flat and inspect cropped balance and hood drape.
qc: Raglan neck/underarm junctions align; no twisted sleeves or cap-ease tucks.
Hood back curve smooth; lining not hanging beyond face; cord runs free.
Buttonhole exits do not tear; no hidden unlisted eyelets.
Rib seams recover after extension; shell not scalloped at attachment.
Neck-to-cuff and CB length within tolerance after 24 h relaxation.
risks: Rib/shrink mismatch may collapse cropped hem or constrict cuff; ratios are trial values.
Self-lined hood weight may pull neckline back; assess on fit model.
Cord length and exits need destination-market adult safety review; no youth compliance claim.
evidence: CONFIRMED in source: burgundy hooded sweatshirt, front/back raglan lines, drawcord, cropped gathered body, rib-look hem band and cuffs.
No kangaroo pocket, zipper or metal eyelet is visible; none specified. Joggers and shoes excluded.
Hood internal layers, cord channel and rib structure are PROPOSED; source does not show inside construction.
assumptions: PROPOSED two-piece hood with self lining (four shell-shaped pieces total); no centre panel added.
Drawcord exits through reinforced stitched buttonholes, not assumed metal eyelets.
Rib is proposed 2×2 matching knit; exact shell/rib composition, recovery and shrinkage remain unverified. Adult garment only; market cord review pending.
consumption: ESTIMATE: shell 1.70–2.00 m at 150 cm usable width, EU 38, non-directional sweatshirt knit, body pair + sleeve pair + four hood panels (self-lined); 15% cutting/shrink reserve. Rib 0.25–0.35 m at 100 cm open width, band/cuffs across stretch. Verify actual marker, nap and laundering shrinkage.
care: TBD: fibre identity, component compatibility, care testing, country of origin and destination-market legal review. Do not print generic care symbols.
labels: PROPOSED: neutral development ID + EU size; 35 × 12 mm soft ID label, ends turned 5 mm and secured with 301. No third-party logo or manufacturer claim. Placement: inside back neck tape plus left side seam.
packaging: PROPOSED: fold only after cooling; use unprinted recyclable protective sleeve sized to the actual folded sample. Bag material, gauge and dimensions TBD after packing trial. One garment per sleeve; no invented approved bag size.
